newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - BANCO ITAU UPPED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BANCO ITAU UPPED.

text.p: ING Barings said in a report it had upgraded Brazil's Banco Itau to buy from hold.
-- said it had raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for Itau to $60.50 and $73.10 per 1,000 shares, respectively, from $57.80 and $68.10.
-- Analyst Nuno Fernandes said the upgrade was based on expectations of stronger earnings from recent acquisitions and strengthened fundamentals related to improved asset quality.
-- "We see the recent acquisitions of Itau Seguros and Banerj as good signs of management's effort to improve the bank's long-term profitability by increasing its financial leverage," he said.

-- Itau, Brazil's second top private bank, took over its sister company Itau Seguros insurance firm in April and bought Rio de Janeiro state bank Banco Banerj SA in the first privatization auction of a Brazilian state-owned bank in June.
-- "Additionally, we are increasingly encouraged with Itau's exceptional loan growth in the quarter and the expectations for a long process of organic expansion of its operations," Fernandes added.
-- The report followed the release of Itau's first-half earnings of 345 million reais earlier this week.
-- No trades were seen with Banco Itau's stock in the first 15 minutes of trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa Friday.
